Hero_Desc_Polan:
The guard captain of the Sprite Kingdom, Erpien.
With her unique popularity and charisma, she has led the Sprite Guard with competence.
However, she tends to be overly obsessive when it comes to Erpin.
Album_Wish_Polan: The Sprite Kingdom becomes safe forever
Album_Polan1: Polan, the Guard Captain of the Sprite Kingdom Erpien, is a sprite who stood by Erpin for many years. She caused a big trouble when she tried to usurp Erpin's throne... but Erpin said she's okay with it, so I guess it's fine.
Album_Polan2: Polan seems to harbor a strange sense of rivalry toward Ner, who practically raised Erpin. She appears jealous and vexed whenever Erpin whines and clings to Ner.
Album_Polan3: The sprite guards obey Polan's every word to the letter. Polan's charisma is so extraordinary that when she attempted to usurp Erpin's throne, even guards who were loyal to Erpin surrendered and switched sides as soon as they saw her...
Album_Polan4: Polan thinks of me as a benefactor who protected Erpin while she was away. She seems quite amazed at how well Erpin follows me... but I'm still a little scared to tell her that I gave Erpin noogies on the head a few times.
Album_Polan5: Polan and Haley meet often and enjoy playing strategy board games. They exchange complex terms while playing games that never seem to end. Watching them makes you drowsy, but they seem to have a lot of fun.
Album_Polan6: Whereas Ner is polite to not only Erpin but also Belita, the queen of the witches, Polan doesn't seem to care much for Belita. She is very wary of witches and is on particularly bad terms with Fricle.
Album_Polan7: Polan is grateful to me for sharing the duties of the Sprite Kingdom so that she could reopen the PE classes for Erpin. Erpin is not good at studying and using her head, and Polan claims that exercise is the answer to Erpin regaining her self-esteem. If Erpin's everyday behavior is any indication, Polan might just be right.
LoveHero_Polan: As you, the Master, protected Her Majesty, I shall protect you.
LoveHeroCancel_Polan: It's time to return to my queen Erpin's side.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Hate1: She shook her head, saying that drinking before guard duty distracts her. It seems the Guard Captain is very thorough when it concerns her duties.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Hate2: She grimaced at the acrid smell of the crème brûlée, saying she's had enough of smelling something burning. It must have stirred up unpleasant memories.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like1: She prefers it because not only is it sweet, but it's also Queen Erpin's favorite. It's apparently very effective when Erpin is sulking.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like10: She took one bite and marveled at how sharply the flavor awakened her senses. Saying she would stock them in the Fairy Kingdom Guard's break room, she packed several to take with her.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like2: She sang the praises of steamed rice with a smile, saying that rice keeps her fueled for duty and is also good to share with the guard underlings. I wonder if she's thinking more in terms of calories than taste.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like3: She was satisfied that since it was warm and tasty, it would be good to distribute to the guards on night duty.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like4: She smiled, saying that the sweet taste of chocolate would really please the queen. She said she would leave some for the queen but was embarrassed when she ended up eating it all.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like5: She liked that the sour flavor seemed to recharge her depleted energy. Was she having a tough time with her guard duties lately?
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like6: She quietly watched me make songpyeon for a while, then asked me about the recipe so she could make them for Erpin herself. I'll tell her later.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like7: She was only going to have a little taste because she had work to do, but she devoured it all in the blink of an eye. Polan must have a sweet tooth, too.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like8: She was delighted that this kind of convenience food did not stain her uniform and was easy to eat. Let's not mention the crumbs around her mouth for a moment.
Food_ChefNote_Polan_Like9: After studying the candy tin closely, she set aside the candy with sprite race properties and ate the rest. The last one was for Erpin, she said.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Polan: I would do anything to defend the Sprite Kingdom.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Polan: If you want victory, you must put everything on the line!
Polan_Spawn1: Guard Captain Polan of Erpien is on the field!
Polan_Spawn2: Everyone, get in formation as ordered!
Polan_Growth: Polan, Guard Captain of the Sprite Kingdom.
Polan_Growth1: I won't stop until I have the strength to be worthy of my queen...!
Polan_Growth2: There may be no higher rank for me to attain, but steady growth is always worthwhile.
Polan_Victory2: I dedicate this victory to Her Majesty!
Polan_Defeat2: My command must have been perfect, so how...?
Polan_Affinity1_1: Long live Her Majesty the Queen!
Polan_Affinity2: Why am I the Guard Captain? Because I can see Her Majesty!
Polan_Affinity3: If Erpien was an empire... everyone would've been happy...
Polan_Affinity4: Thank you for always taking care of Her Majesty, Master.
Polan_Affinity5: My victory is Erpien's victory! I will not be defeated!
Polan_Affinity6: Sneaking in fried carrots among candy canes! It must be the work of witches!
Polan_Affinity7: Her Majesty is simply perfect. But it's a shame that she's like a rose without thorns.
Polan_LevelUp: Steady training is the key to fighting!
Polan_Equipment: These supplies are of good quality.
Polan_HeroSkill: We can test out new tactics.
Polan_HeroUpgrade: I shall use this power... for the defense of Erpien!
Polan_Board: You want me to go this way?
Polan_DeckSetting1: If you need my power, I'll gladly oblige!
Polan_Stage: It's time to go to war.
Polan_Touch1: Ugh, please let me uphold my authority as the Guard Captain!
Polan_Touch1_1: If possible, please do this where my subordinates cannot see...
Polan_Touch2_1: This manner of commendation... is unfamiliar to me.
Polan_Touch1_2: I do not fall asleep on duty, so there is no need to pull them.
Polan_Touch2_2: Well... do as much as you want.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Polan_Skin1: Polan has resolved to dress up for an outing. Perhaps she finds her own appearance unfamiliar, because she blushes whenever our eyes meet.
Polan_Growth1_Skin1: I look forward to today's date... No, our outing.
Polan_Growth2_Skin1: I shall attend to you today. Simply leave everything to me.
Polan_LevelUp_Skin1: Now I can protect you even better.
Polan_Equipment_Skin1: I gratefully accept this gift. I shall repay you someday...
Polan_HeroSkill_Skin1: There are things to learn even while resting!
Polan_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: For today, I shall use this power for you.
Polan_Board_Skin1: Is the outing spot over there?
Polan_Touch1_Skin1: Is this a reminder that I must not let down my guard?
Polan_Touch1_1_Skin1: I-I merely let my guard down during our outing. It will not happen next time.
Polan_Touch1_2_Skin1: I worked hard on my appearance, and now it will be ruined.
Polan_Touch2_Skin1: Did a petal fall on my head? Are you brushing it away?
Polan_Touch2_1_Skin1: I had not realized your hand was so warm.
Polan_Touch2_2_Skin1: Perhaps it is because we are on an outing... My heart feels warm.
Polan_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: This was supposed to be a nice outing... You're so mean!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Polan_Skin2: Polan wears this outfit for the traditional spearmanship tournament held in Erpien. Among its many contestants, she has apparently never failed to claim first place.
Polan_Growth1_Skin2: I grow for the sake of victory.
Polan_Growth2_Skin2: My spear feels even lighter now.
Polan_LevelUp_Skin2: I shall win the next match as well.
Polan_Equipment_Skin2: Did you prepare this for me? Thank you!
Polan_HeroSkill_Skin2: My technique has grown even more refined.
Polan_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: I shall become an even stronger knight.
Polan_Board_Skin2: It is not heavy! I shall run!
Polan_Touch1_Skin2: You truly know no fear, Master.
Polan_Touch1_1_Skin2: For victory, I can endure a humiliation like this!
Polan_Touch1_2_Skin2: Are you trying to help me relax?
Polan_Touch2_Skin2: Haah... Now I can concentrate even better on the match.
Polan_Touch2_1_Skin2: I must be sweaty after training...
Polan_Touch2_2_Skin2: Your touch is sweeter than victory.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Polan_Skin3: Polan has become the flight attendant responsible for safety aboard the Bread Cruiser. She approaches her duties with passion to protect every passenger.
Polan_Growth1_Skin3: I promise you a journey with every detail accounted for.
Polan_Growth2_Skin3: I shall serve you with the finest hospitality.
Polan_LevelUp_Skin3: You may safely leave it to me!
Polan_Equipment_Skin3: I shall be a model worthy of this uniform!
Polan_HeroSkill_Skin3: My orders have become more precise.
Polan_HeroUpgrade_Skin3: A promotion, I see. Thank you!
Polan_Touch1_1_Skin3: Playing pranks on the crew is prohibited!
Polan_Touch2_1_Skin3: Thank you for placing your trust in me.
Polan_Touch2_2_Skin3: It feels as though I am wrapped in clouds.
Polan_DutchRubEnd2_Skin3: Would you like to be ejected in an emergency?
Aside_Get_Polan1: Will this outfit suit me? It will, right? This is embarrassing...
Aside_Upgrade_Polan1: Loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me not, loves me...
Polan_AsideGet: Will this outfit suit me? It will, right? This is embarrassing...
Polan_AsideUpgrade: Loves me, loves me not, loves me, loves me not, loves me...
Polan_Birthday: Happy birthday, Master. Please continue to support Her Majesty and Erpien.
Polan_Gacha2: If you seek victory, you must stake everything.
Polan_Gacha3: I will do anything to protect the Fairy Kingdom.
Polan_Greeting: It is a pleasure to meet you.
Polan_Line1: I can do anything for Queen Erpin and Erpien.
Polan_Line2: Fairy Kingdom Guard, all clear today.
Polan_Line3: Have you come to see Her Majesty? Pardon? You mean me?
LoveLetter_Polan:
Greetings, Master. This is Polan, Captain of the Fairy Kingdom Guard!

After meeting and spending so much time with you, I feel that I now understand a little of why Queen Erpin relies upon you and feels so grateful. The way you greet me whenever we meet while I patrol around the Order, and how you seek out and prepare everyone's favorite food in the banquet hall... Those qualities must be why Her Majesty and all the other residents acknowledge you.

Please continue to look after me and Her Majesty, as well as the Fairy Kingdom and all of Elias!
LoveCall_Polan:
Master, this is Guard Captain Polan.
I am not contacting you to deliver an official report, but to express my gratitude.
Thank you for always working alongside the High Priest on the kingdom and Order's external affairs and diplomatic activities.
Through your grace, the kingdom and the Order prosper more with every passing day.
As Captain of the Guard, nothing could make me prouder than watching the Fairy Kingdom's standing rise.

I can no longer even imagine the days before you were here.
Master, I know how busy you usually are, but might you be able to spare some time?
I am not asking for an official reason.
I simply feel that I would like to spend time with you personally.
Even when I take leave these days, there is nothing in particular for me to do, so I would be glad if you kept me company.
Thank you for hearing me out, Master.
Affinity_Polan_EP01_001: Looking back now, I believe I treated Her Majesty with far too much arrogance.
Affinity_Polan_EP01_002: Erpin may have a childish side, but she is not truly a child.
Affinity_Polan_EP01_003: Yes. I failed to understand the weight of the crown Her Majesty carried... Shamefully so.
Affinity_Polan_EP01_004: No... It was understandable. If anything, you were the normal one.
Affinity_Polan_EP01_005: You speak as though you see through everything yourself, Master. Are you confident that you will have no regrets?
Affinity_Polan_EP01_006: Were you not acting for Erpin's sake in your own way?
Affinity_Polan_EP01_007: That is true... but righteous intentions do not justify wrongful actions.
Affinity_Polan_EP02_001: What do you think about separating royal authority from religious authority, Master?
Affinity_Polan_EP02_002: I am amazed that you Sprites even know such a concept.
Affinity_Polan_EP02_003: How long do you think the kingdom's history has endured? Do not underestimate Sprites.
Affinity_Polan_EP02_004: What an insolent question. You are excommunicated.
Affinity_Polan_EP02_005: Wh-what? You can do that too, Master? Will you reinstate me if I buy an indulgence?
Affinity_Polan_EP02_006: As long as Ner is there, the separation exists in name only.
Affinity_Polan_EP02_007: Haaah... Someday Her Majesty will have to become independent from the High Priest too.
Affinity_Polan_EP03_001: The Sprite Kingdom needs a more independent system for procuring food.
Affinity_Polan_EP03_002: You do not trust the Elves who supply your sugar?
Affinity_Polan_EP03_003: It is not a matter of trust. I am simply stating an orthodox principle of diplomacy.
Affinity_Polan_EP03_004: I am glad that at least you think that way.
Affinity_Polan_EP03_005: Even when everyone is satisfied, must someone not remain vigilant?
Affinity_Polan_EP03_006: First, let us appoint Kyarot as the official in charge of agriculture.
Affinity_Polan_EP03_007: Uh... That friend is a little too... willful to hold high office...
Affinity_Polan_EP04_001: The Elves' strategy... was astonishingly sophisticated. It came as something of a shock at first.
Affinity_Polan_EP04_002: Where did you learn about the Elves' military strategy?
Affinity_Polan_EP04_003: Through exchanges with Elf officers. Do you know an Elf officer named Haley?
Affinity_Polan_EP04_004: They were thoroughly defeated on Earth anyway.
Affinity_Polan_EP04_005: There is no perfect strategy in this world. Losing once does not diminish its value.
Affinity_Polan_EP04_006: Still... How much strategy could Sprites possibly devise?
Affinity_Polan_EP04_007: How rude. Just how much do you know about strategy to say such a thing, Master?
Affinity_Polan_EP05_001: Sometimes the High Priest... seems like a Sprite who knows no gratitude.
Affinity_Polan_EP05_002: Exactly. Ner should learn to be grateful. To me as well.
Affinity_Polan_EP05_003: That was not what I meant... It seems you have experienced something upsetting.
Affinity_Polan_EP05_004: I do not quite understand. What do you mean?
Affinity_Polan_EP05_005: I mean gratitude for Her Majesty's service and responsibility. The High Priest could acknowledge them from time to time...
Affinity_Polan_EP05_006: Ner simply has no leisure to express her feelings honestly.
Affinity_Polan_EP05_007: ...I see. Please forget what I said. It was a hasty remark.
Affinity_Polan_EP06_001: If only I had exercised better command from the start, I could have suppressed the rebellion swiftly...
Affinity_Polan_EP06_002: At a more fundamental level, was it not Erpin's fault...?
Affinity_Polan_EP06_003: But is it not a retainer's role to correct the mistakes of their sovereign?
Affinity_Polan_EP06_004: An officer of your caliber could not bring the situation under control?
Affinity_Polan_EP06_005: The situation was extremely chaotic... Even so, many subordinates supported me.
Affinity_Polan_EP06_006: Do not take it too much to heart. Everything worked out in the end.
Affinity_Polan_EP06_007: Thanks to you, Master. Though belated, allow me to express my gratitude.
Affinity_Polan_EP07_001: Escort duty feels rather different from ordinary assignments.
Affinity_Polan_EP07_002: Does Erpin even need an escort in the first place?
Affinity_Polan_EP07_003: She is not just anyone. She is Her Majesty the Queen! Great personal strength does not eliminate the need for an escort!
Affinity_Polan_EP07_005: Correcting the spelling in her illustrated diary and carrying her things on bakery tours... Hmm... Escort duties are confidential.
Affinity_Polan_EP07_006: Do you follow Erpin around while calling her 'milady'?
Affinity_Polan_EP07_007: Who would do something so embarrassing?! ...It might suit Her Majesty surprisingly well...
Affinity_Polan_EP08_001: Tell me honestly. Why do you support Her Majesty so devotedly?
Affinity_Polan_EP08_002: 'Take care of' would be more accurate than 'support.'
Affinity_Polan_EP08_003: You share the High Priest's view too, Master? The Order is hardly trustworthy.
Affinity_Polan_EP08_004: One cannot pass by a child playing beside a well.
Affinity_Polan_EP08_005: You mean you acted out of moral duty? That is a rather old-fashioned answer.
Affinity_Polan_EP08_007: I see. Looking into your eyes, I do not believe I need to ask any further.
Affinity_Polan_EP09_001: Sometimes the admiring gazes directed at me feel burdensome.
Affinity_Polan_EP09_002: Admiration... is the emotion furthest from understanding.
Affinity_Polan_EP09_003: Oh, you possess literary talent, Master. That is a fine sentence.
Affinity_Polan_EP09_004: Still, it must be better since your three-day reign ended.
Affinity_Polan_EP09_005: Ugh, was there truly a need to prod that sore spot?
Affinity_Polan_EP09_006: Would it not be far better than gazes filled with hostility?
Affinity_Polan_EP09_007: Not at all. Hostility is easy to repel, but expectations are difficult to cast aside.
Affinity_Polan_EP10_001: Her Majesty told me what you did while I was away, Master.
Affinity_Polan_EP10_002: Yes, yes. Now that you have heard, serve her properly.
Affinity_Polan_EP10_003: Your present attitude makes the story somewhat less credible... I will simply consider you a rather glib person.
Affinity_Polan_EP10_005: Master! Do you think Her Majesty is some kind of goldfish?!
Affinity_Polan_EP10_006: It was not that remarkable. Many people around me helped.
Affinity_Polan_EP10_007: Many endeavors fail even after receiving help. There is no need to be so humble.
Affinity_Polan_EP11_001: Haaah... Her Majesty has once again...
Affinity_Polan_EP11_002: Why? Did Erpin cause another incident?
Affinity_Polan_EP11_003: Withdraw that statement immediately. Even from you, Master, I will not tolerate an insult to Her Majesty in my presence!
Affinity_Polan_EP11_005: Yes. She achieved the remarkable feat of earning full marks on ten consecutive practical physical education tests!
Affinity_Polan_EP11_006: What are you trying to say?
Affinity_Polan_EP11_007: Are you not pleased to hear news of Her Majesty? I know perfectly well that you are curious inside.
Affinity_Polan_EP12_001: The Beastfolk's board games are strange. I have never heard of a strategy game in which my extraordinary strategy does not work!
Affinity_Polan_EP12_002: I can picture exactly how the Chow Rebels defeated you...
Affinity_Polan_EP12_003: So I was not their only victim? I thought I felt a sense of kinship.
Affinity_Polan_EP12_004: Surely you did not play board games during duty hours?
Affinity_Polan_EP12_005: What? Her Majesty asked me to play just one round, so I merely kept her company!
Affinity_Polan_EP12_006: Why not accept your defeat gracefully?
Affinity_Polan_EP12_007: Ugh... It pains me, but you are correct. No one listens to the excuses of the defeated on a real battlefield.
Affinity_Polan_EP13_001: I would like to hear your esteemed opinion on how to strengthen unity among the guards.
Affinity_Polan_EP13_002: You certainly endure a great deal of hardship.
Affinity_Polan_EP13_003: What...? Yes, thank you for recognizing that. But do you have no separate answer to my request for advice...?
Affinity_Polan_EP13_004: As Guard Captain, you must become their firm center.
Affinity_Polan_EP13_005: Hmm... Then the risk of collapse when I am absent would be far too great.
Affinity_Polan_EP13_006: How about holding a team-building competition?
Affinity_Polan_EP13_007: Oh, now that you mention it, the time to hold another competition seems to be approaching.
Affinity_Polan_EP14_001: Are you satisfied with your present life, Master?
Affinity_Polan_EP14_002: I simply live as events carry me along.
Affinity_Polan_EP14_003: I wish you would show a little more spirit, so that you may continue protecting Her Majesty and this kingdom beside me.
Affinity_Polan_EP14_004: I am satisfied. Every day is enjoyable.
Affinity_Polan_EP14_005: Then I am relieved. I worried that the weight of your office might be pressing down on you while you suffered alone.
Affinity_Polan_EP14_006: What, are you a spy Ner sent?!
Affinity_Polan_EP14_007: What? High Priest Ner is not in a position to issue orders to me!
Affinity_Polan_EP15_001: Bivouacking is truly enjoyable. Would you care to join us sometime, Master?
Affinity_Polan_EP15_003: I would dearly love for her to join us... but no. I cannot allow Her Majesty to sleep on the cold ground!
Affinity_Polan_EP15_004: If it is training, I would rather not participate...
Affinity_Polan_EP15_005: To think you do not know the joys of bivouac training. How regrettable.
Affinity_Polan_EP15_007: You are always prepared? Just as I thought, there is much I can learn from you, Master.
Affinity_Polan_EP16_002: Call Polan while imitating Erpin's voice.
Affinity_Polan_EP16_003: Did you just imitate Her Majesty's voice? It did not sound like her at all.
Affinity_Polan_EP16_004: Quietly drape a garment over her shoulders.
Affinity_Polan_EP16_005: Ah, the comfortable atmosphere I have not felt in so long made me fall asleep without realizing it. Thank you for your warm consideration.
Affinity_Polan_EP16_007: H-hwaaargh?! ...Oh, it was you, Master. I thought another rebellion had broken out.
Affinity_Polan_EP17_001: Hmm...? I believe I smell the musty odor of an underground place somewhere.
Affinity_Polan_EP17_002: Are you mocking me for not cleaning the Banquet Hall?
Affinity_Polan_EP17_003: What? That was not what I meant... Still, Her Majesty visits this place, so please maintain strict cleanliness!
Affinity_Polan_EP17_004: Could you be... a friend of Butter?
Affinity_Polan_EP17_005: If you mean Butter from the Beastfolk Village, we are acquainted. But why ask that so suddenly...?
Affinity_Polan_EP17_006: A group of witches just held a dinner gathering here.
Affinity_Polan_EP17_007: I see... My sense of smell did not deceive me. I simply cannot understand witches' taste in food.
Affinity_Polan_EP18_001: I hear the view from the summit of Elemental Mountain is beautiful. I would like to visit it at least once someday.
Affinity_Polan_EP18_002: I will tell the Elementals to expect you. Go visit.
Affinity_Polan_EP18_003: For the sake of honoring your kindness, Master, I must make time for it soon.
Affinity_Polan_EP18_005: Her Majesty detests mountain climbing. I do not wish for her to hate me!
Affinity_Polan_EP18_006: You mean you have never been there?
Affinity_Polan_EP18_007: I have not been in a position to take leave for personal matters.
Affinity_Polan_EP19_001: 'Uneasy lies the head that wears a crown'... It is a truly frightening passage.
Affinity_Polan_EP19_003: Yes. I will never allow Her Majesty to bear the weight of the crown alone.
Affinity_Polan_EP19_004: Not everyone can wear a crown.
Affinity_Polan_EP19_005: Precisely. That must be why its weight feels all the heavier.
Affinity_Polan_EP19_006: Is there anything even the Guard Captain fears?
Affinity_Polan_EP19_007: Before I am the Guard Captain, I am an ordinary Sprite like any other. Of course there are things I fear!
Affinity_Polan_EP20_001: Do you have anything sweeter? It is merely a matter of curiosity.
Affinity_Polan_EP20_002: That does not sound like mere curiosity.
Affinity_Polan_EP20_003: Wh-what do you mean?! I asked only out of pure curiosity!
Affinity_Polan_EP20_004: Anything sweeter than this would be bizarre food...
Affinity_Polan_EP20_005: Are you saying we Sprites eat bizarre food? That goes too far!
Affinity_Polan_EP20_006: I will make it if you want.
Affinity_Polan_EP20_007: Truly? Then please make it as sweet as possible!
